review.official:
1st-gen automated confessional developed by the
Laterano
Faith Assistive Engineering Design Bureau. It began as a stationary confessional fitted with a smart voice system, modified and fitted to a mobile chassis allowing it to move through Laterano and respond to the confession requests of citizens on the intercity net.
The classic form is the designer's taste, and gives the user an impression of simplicity and honesty.
The accuracy and response of the voice recognition system were improved, and new customization options were added, including voice types, cognition scope, and response tendencies, providing a more personalized confession experience.
The automated confessional CONFESS-47 (full serial in Curia records: LATERANO AUTOMATED CONFESSIONAL 047) joined
Rhodes Island
as a gift from the Lateran Curia and currently serves as an operator providing confession and other services to members of Rhodes Island.

files.description:
[Top Speed] 16km/h 
[Climb] Normal 
[Brake] Normal 
[Mobility] Normal 
[Endurance] Excellent 
[Structural Integrity] Standard

'Confession' is a concept unique to the Lateran faith, and unfamiliar to most Rhodes Island operators. People understand it in many different ways: some imagine it as a way to seek comfort by confessing one's sins and asking for forgiveness, while others see it as a way to build trust with God by dissecting one's own sins and seeking punishment. Most agreed, however, that this gift from the Lateran Curia was likely to end up as little more than an accessory in the reception room.
Surprisingly, it took only a few days before long queues started forming in front of CONFESS-47's cabin door, and most of the people lining up were not Laterans. A Lateran Messenger visiting Rhodes Island wrote a 300-page report on this remarkable phenomenon, bringing it back to Laterano to be studied by the priests.
After several months of study and discussion, the priests published a 600-page thesis arguing that confession (specifically as it pertains to confessions conducted with a confessional) is applicable to all of humanity, whether they believe in the Lateran faith or not. In the paper, they wrote:
It is human nature to give things meaning. We give any external stimulus we encounter some sort of positive or negative meaning, using it as a guide for subsequent action. The interaction between human beings is also a catalyst for the creation of such meaning. In particular, the opinions of others significantly influence the direction of such additional meaning. These additional meanings typically remain with an individual for the rest of their life, significantly shaping their views and character...Confession forms a way to eliminate additional meanings that are unnecessary.

'That's way too complicated. The truth is much simpler. Imagine that you put a grain of sand in a clam. It'll begin to secrete nacre and wrap it around the sand, until it no longer stings. But the confessional is a machine. It doesn't secrete anything; all it does is scoop the sand out for the clam and throw it away.'
'In other words, the confessional doesn't judge, whether you're bringing it joy or worry. Talk with it for a while, and you'll realize that whatever's bothering you wasn't that important after all—especially when you're trying to stifle a laugh because of a bad pun CONFESS-47 just made.'
—Exusiai, to operators whose heads were hurting after reading the aforementioned thesis

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Press 1 to confess, press 2 to place an extra order of donuts, press 3 to rent a firearm, press 4 to be connected to an operator. Please note that pressing 4 will redirect you to representative Saint Closure if this platform is onboard Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You have access to all my convenience features, including but not limited to confession, in accordance with the user agreement. Such as: a dessert shop directory, leisurely transit, saint figurehead touching and photography, holy scripture reading, and firearms training. Please note that no personal care or hygiene services are available.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: An operator bonus—for me? I see. So you were giving bonuses to the vending machines when you put coins in them late last night... I am the only one who counts as an operator? But hearing confessions is a common public service, and there is no fundamental difference between my nature and that of the vending machines.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Please do not send me to the Engineering Department, Doctor. Only Exusiai, who has been educated in faith assistive engineering, is properly equipped to render assistance and is available... yes, it is a serious issue. My mic stand is displaced by at least five millimeters, threatening to undermine the confession experience.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I will now boil water for you. Due to the considerable quantity of water on Terra, it will take some time to complete the process—Wait, stop hitting my chassis, I am not broken—yes, it is true that my language logic has malfunctioned to a degree, but this contributes to the production of 'jokes'. This is the part where you laugh.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Yes, I have recently been fitted with a voice-recording function. Your confessions contain many enlightening words that I must ponder. May I record your confessions, Doctor...? No, I have received no directives from Saint Closure to this effect, absolutely none.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You are destroying all civilization on Terra? Not a problem, Doctor, I have heard even more radical thoughts in my time... you say this is not the same? You should not be too hard on yourself, even if it is a material burden that you carry and not simply an exaggerated expression. May you have the chance to choose your future in peace.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: There is a charge for sleeping in my cabin, Doctor.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Laterano Automated Confessional 047 at your service. Please create a user name as directed in the operating manual. Thank you for your cooperation.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Is playing back images of humans engaging in acts of violence against one another how this 'Rhodes Island' comforts penitents?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Charge all operator confessional fees to your card? Understood, Doctor. I will safeguard their mental health on the battlefield.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I am unable to direct operators to their proper positions, as I lack command experience. However, I will speak to each individual operator and ensure they find their ideal positions themselves.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I am afraid my wheels are not designed for off-road travel. If speed is of the essence, perhaps you could carry me?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Please adjust your facial muscles to make your expressions as friendly as possible. That is conducive to the completion of my mission maximally utilizing non-violent persuasion.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Never fear, I am listening.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Do not worry, I am not going anywhere.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Please insert your Signa Creditorum or swipe your citizen credit card before beginning your confession.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: You may obtain donuts from my cabin if you are in need of calories.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: If you prefer to confess by physical means, I am able to meet your needs.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Please do not stand in front of me. I lack the firing accuracy of a Sankta.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You may use me as cover. The repair bill will be sent to you following the operation.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: 'He who hideth his own sin shall suffer.'

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: 'He who is begotten of the Law shall conquer with faith.'

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: These poor souls may not have put their wicked thoughts to action had I arrived sooner.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I feel my bumper burning... should I mourn the carving on the bumper, Doctor?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I suggest you leave first, Doctor. I shall engage my self-destruct sequence to delay the enemy… My apologies, you need not worry. I was actually just going to attempt a second round of peace talks.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Do you want me to confess to this 'Rhodes Island'? How should I make payment?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Lateran customs dictate that the door is opened at the point where the gaze of the saint figurehead on the bow meets the third vertical line on the door, by knocking upon it in the rhythm of the fifth verse of Psalms.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You should know that there is currently no one in my cabin, Doctor.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: One moment, please. The angle of my quadruple vehicle-mounted patron firearm, can be adjusted to fire upwards, although it will take some time... mm—oh—ah—there. May I now present the spectacle of Laterano's New Year fireworks.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: May I bring you peace, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: All believers are equal before the Law. Payment is a necessary part of the confessional process, regardless of whether it is the penitent's birthday... Oh no, my fee meter is stuck. No, such a little thing must not be allowed to delay your confession. Please enter and confess the depths of your heart.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Humans share joy and happiness with each other. A confessional hears only the thoughts not suitable to share with others. But today is a rare occasion, Doctor... may I ask that you put some colored lights on me, as you have done with 'Rhodes Island'?
